name: Lin Ling
storyline: Lin Ling is a political‑themed single‑player visual‑novel adventure with hand‑drawn art. Players will navigate complex political games, make critical choices that shape the development of the whole story, and witness the fates of different characters in a turbulent world. Every decision carries far‑reaching consequences.
summary:
Lin Ling is a choice‑driven indie visual‑novel game on PC. Step into a realistic‑style story filled with complicated relationships, tough decisions and hidden secrets.

Players will make critical choices that shape the plot and lead you toward multiple different endings. Every decision carries real‑world consequences, and there is no perfectly safe option.

Featuring original hand‑drawn artwork, atmospheric background music and well‑written character dialogues, this narrative experience is great for streaming. Viewers can watch and discuss your in‑game choices, making each playthrough unique and fun for audiences.

Play through different branches, unlock character stories and discover all possible endings. If you enjoy story‑rich games with meaningful player choices, Lin Ling offers you a memorable experience.
